# The S/MIME regeneration script copies the remote-image fixture into browser test data

The regeneration script adds alice.remoteimage.env.eml to the copy list for the browser-test data directory. A fixed browser consumer opens that filename through getTestFilePath before waiting for the decrypted test element. The selected commit changes the script and readme, so it does not itself add a browser assertion or establish remote-image blocking, successful decryption or fixture generation. No script, native tool or browser test ran.

Scope: S/MIME generated browser fixture packaging.
